title: Docs: add profile pack config examples + inline comments; update runtime config reference
author: Elliot Price
body:
Summary: This PR improves in-repo documentation for the hardware tuning profiles pack by (1) adding concrete config examples (H100 / L40S / B200-preview) and (2) updating the runtime config reference to document the new/changed fields and override precedence. Motivation: We’ve had repeated questions from SRE + Support during canary bring-up about which knobs are required vs best-effort in Hosted/Dedicated/Private, and what a “safe” customer pin looks like. The Confluence pages are great for narrative, but we need in-repo docs co-located with the schema + defaults so runtime-1.22 ships with self-contained references. Changes: - Add example profile pack definitions with comments calling out trade-offs/guardrails (batch/concurrency, scheduler mode, KV cache headroom/compaction, kernel variant selection/fallback). - Document selection + override precedence in runtime config reference: fleet default profile_version -> per-deployment pin -> per-customer pin (Dedicated/Private) -> explicit per-model overrides, with guardrails enforced by validation (unsupported SKU/driver/CUDA => hard error for B200, warn+fallback for others). - Add a short troubleshooting appendix (“what to check when p99 regresses”) pointing to the runtime’s new startup log line and profile tags on latency histograms. Notes / non-goals: This does not change runtime behavior; it documents fields that are being introduced/landed in other PRs (schema loader, selection logic, observability tags). It intentionally avoids enumerating every knob; only those surfaced in the profile pack schema. Cross-links: Related PRs: #24873 (loader + schema), #24881 (selection + overrides), #24935 (profile_id/sku tags), #25014 (health/debug endpoint shows profile version). Release: Targeting runtime-1.22 (docs should be ready before Hosted canary expands). Checklist: - [x] Examples validated via schema (copied from golden snapshots) - [x] Consistent naming with runtime flags and Helm values - [x] Reviewed by Runtime + Release Eng for accuracy - [x] No internal-only links required to understand basics (Confluence links are optional) Inline example (excerpt): profile_id: h100-sxm-prod-v1
compatibility: sku: H100-SXM; min_driver: 550.54; min_cuda: 12.4
scheduler: mode: bucketed_mixed; queue_limit: 256; prefill_priority: high
kv_cache: headroom_gb: 7; compaction: enabled; compaction_trigger: 0.82
kernels: attention: h100_v3_prefer; fallback: h100_v2_on_long_ctx
comments: "Increase queue_limit only if p99 is stable; see scheduler_queue_ms dashboard."
commits: docs(runtime): add profile pack examples for H100/L40S/B200-preview
docs(runtime): update config reference for profile_version + override precedence
docs: add troubleshooting section for profile-related perf regressions
chore(docs): normalize terminology (profile_id vs profile_version) and fix links
conversation:
Omar El-Sayed (review): Can we explicitly call out which fields are enforced vs advisory? In particular, kv_cache.headroom_gb has hard guardrails and should be described that way so Support doesn’t suggest unsafe pins.
Elliot Price (author): Good call — updated the reference to label each field as (required/validated) vs (best-effort) and added a note that headroom is clamped and may be rejected depending on SKU.

Sofia Ivanova (review): The scheduler section says “prefill_priority: high reduces tail latency” — that’s true for mixed workloads but can hurt throughput on pure decode. Can we phrase that as a trade-off and point to which workload bucket it targets?
Elliot Price (author): Updated wording to: “Prefill prioritization reduces mixed-workload p99 at the cost of throughput in decode-heavy buckets.” Also added a one-liner mapping of the default buckets.

Allison Grant (review): Please align metric names in the troubleshooting section with what’s actually exported. I think it’s scheduler_queue_ms (histogram) and kernel_choice_total (counter), not kernel_fallback_rate.
Elliot Price (author): Fixed names + added PromQL examples used in the Runtime Profiles dashboard panels.

Connor O'Brien (review): For release-1.22, can we ensure the docs reference the exact config keys that ship (profile_version vs profile.pack.version)? Also please add a short note on backport policy: doc changes can be cherry-picked without runtime changes.
Elliot Price (author): Synced key names to match runtime config reference in main; added a release note paragraph: “docs-only updates may be backported to release/* branches as needed.”

CI: ✅ build-and-test (12m) ✅ docs-lint (1m) ✅ link-check (3m) ✅ schema-example-validate (2m)

Merged by Connor O'Brien (squash) after approvals from Omar, Sofia, Allison.
release_notes: Internal: In-repo docs now include profile pack config examples and updated runtime config reference for profile_version/override precedence (runtime-1.22 readiness).
